purpose: A visual and semantic group of related buttons without adding selection behavior.
behaviorProvider: Native div with group semantics; child buttons own activation.

component: Render a div with role group and a required aria-label. Forward ordinary div attributes and merge className with button-group.
Provide no selection model, roving focus or group keyboard interception; each child retains its own native button behavior.
host: Supply a meaningful group name and explicit button types. Use ToggleGroup or SegmentedControl when exclusive selection is required.
Keep action order and emphasis consistent across the product; authorization and action completion belong to the host.

requirements.statement: Render a div with role group and a required aria-label. Forward ordinary div attributes and merge className with button-group.
Provide no selection model, roving focus or group keyboard interception; each child retains its own native button behavior.
Supply a meaningful group name and explicit button types. Use ToggleGroup or SegmentedControl when exclusive selection is required.
Keep action order and emphasis consistent across the product; authorization and action completion belong to the host.

Use trigger group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: Visual grouping does not implement a toolbar, selection, validation or async action lifecycle.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
